charities.description: Make-A-Wish grants the wishes of children with life-threatening medical conditions to enrich the human experience with hope, strength and joy. Make-A-Wish is the world's largest wish-granting organization, serving children in nearly 50 countries on five continents. With the help of generous donors and more than 40,000 volunteers worldwide, Make-A-Wish grants a wish somewhere in the world every 17 minutes on average. Since 1980, it has granted more than 500,000 wishes to children around the world.
charities.name: Make-A-Wish International

data.description:
Get the most out of the vast open world of *Dying Light 2: Stay Human* with this bundle of *Dying Light 2* DLC! In this giant collection of extras (main game not included) you’ll find tons of useful items to upgrade your journey through Villedor and beyond. The Welcome Offer: Essential Starter Kit includes a resource bundle, an XP booster, and a deadly serrated kukri! The G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle has everything you need to clean up the city while avoiding contamination! And if you’re looking for some light reading material, the Goodies Pack–Arts includes a digital artbook for the game, a digital comic, and some ready-to-print wallpapers! Enhance your experience parkouring through the wilds and wastelands of *Dying Light 2* with this DLC collection, pay what you want, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!\
\
[Buy Dying Light 2 Stay Human on the Humble Store to unlock this content!](https://www.humblebundle.com/store/dying-light-2-stay-human-reloaded-edition)\
\
Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 21st, 2027.
data.headline: Enhance your Dying Light 2 experience

bundled_dlc_names: G.R.E. Hazmat Outfit
Hazmat Gear Items
Biohazard Pay SMG — The quickest way to clear out an area, and with each kill, your damage output increases until you reload!

Bonecutter Axe — Guns are fun and all, but sometimes you want to get up close and personal and really hack at your foes. With this axe, their limbs will come off so much easier! Good thing you're wearing a hazmat suit.
G.R.E. Token Charm — The G.R.E. were always looking for Infected Trophies, and with this charm, you’ll get some every time you dismantle it depending on how many zombies you’ve “taken care” of.
G.R.E. Grappling Hook — Zombie or not, if they’re trying to escape, you can’t let them get away.
Hazardous Paraglider — Seeing this in the sky will make any enemy start running away from your landing zone.
500 DL Points — For you to spend in the in-game store!*
items.description:
These guys were responsible for keeping the virus contained. Just look at how that turned out. Now, don their outfit and use their equipment to show them what they should have done and take care of the situation in Villedor yourself!
\
\
Show the G.R.E. how to take care of the situation in Villedor!
\
\
It’s hard work, but someone’s got to go in and clean up the messes the G.R.E. leaves in their wake. But not you! Grab the G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle right now and add to the carnage left all over Villedor. Plus, the bundle comes with 500 DL Points to spend in the in-game store, too!\*

Before and during the early days of the outbreak, these guys were taking care of the situation within the labs and quarantined buildings, but then all hell broke loose. Now it’s time to clean up The City, once and for all!
\

The G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle contains:

- G.R.E. Hazmat Outfit
- Hazmat Gear Items
- Biohazard Pay SMG — The quickest way to clear out an area, and with each kill, your damage output increases until you reload!
- Bonecutter Axe — Guns are fun and all, but sometimes you want to get up close and personal and really hack at your foes. With this axe, their limbs will come off so much easier! Good thing you're wearing a hazmat suit.
- G.R.E. Token Charm — The G.R.E. were always looking for Infected Trophies, and with this charm, you’ll get some every time you dismantle it depending on how many zombies you’ve “taken care” of.
- G.R.E. Grappling Hook — Zombie or not, if they’re trying to escape, you can’t let them get away.
- Hazardous Paraglider — Seeing this in the sky will make any enemy start running away from your landing zone.
- 500 DL Points — For you to spend in the in-game store!\*

\*Disclaimer: Due to Japanese laws and regulations, the 500 DL Points are not included in the G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle for purchases made within Japan.

Regular Bolts & Fire Bolts — become a proper firestarter with these special bolts. Just don’t forget to reload.

items.description:
Become the fierce nightrunner hellbent on survival with the new Hakon Bundle. Arm yourself with charm, wit, and the tools necessary to navigate through the treacherous nights of The City.
\
Channel Hakon’s signature style (and charm) then pop some Infected heads with his trademark bow. And if you wanna be a real hot shot, add a fire bolt; that way things will really start heating up. But don’t worry if you can’t handle the heat (or you run into an old flame), Hakon’s paraglider will make sure you can make a quick getaway!
\
\
**This bundle contains:**
\

- Hakon’s Appearance — do whatever you need to survive, and look good while doing it.
  \
- Hakon's Crossbow — aim steady, and let them take an arrow to the knee... or the head.
  \
- Regular Bolts & Fire Bolts — become a proper firestarter with these special bolts. Just don’t forget to reload.
  \
- Hakon’s Paraglider — this paraglider may help you flee from a horde of Infected or… a romantic exploit gone bad.

items.description:
Celebrate the 10th Anniversary of Call of Juarez® Gunslinger with a special bundle that pays homage to the bounty hunter Silas Greaves.
\
\
It’s time to bring some of the old ways back to The City. Put on your cowboy hat, don the red poncho, roll up your sleeves, and duel with anyone who dares to look at you funny. Whether they’re undead or alive, your enemies won’t know what hit them as you drop dynamite, cut through them with your trusty knife, or better yet, drop from the sky using the new paraglider. Whatever you do, show ‘em all why true gunslingers say that if you climb in the saddle, you’d better be ready for the ride.
\
\
This bundle contains:
\

- Silas Greaves Outfit – vengeance will lead the way on this one, with the stench of death not far behind.

- The Gunslinger – leave your horse at the stables. Travel with a paraglider that bears an image of the famous bounty hunter instead.

\
It’s time for the original runners to show Nightrunners how it’s really done.

Chicken Claw — cut, scratch, and slice your foes like the true cocky rooster you are, with a bleeding effect on top of that!
Chicken Wing — why did the chicken jump off the roof? Well, to soar through the skies with this new paraglider skin.
items.description:
Become a one-of-a-kind angry bird.
\
It’s time to shake a tail feather and establish a new pecking order in The City. As a chicken that fears no one, you have to break some bad eggs to make an omelet. Use a claw that can cut and scratch your enemies until they become a chicken-hearted mess. And if someone dares to doubt your ability to fly, prove them wrong by taking it to the skies with a featherweight paraglider.
\
\
**The bundle contains:**
\

- Rooster Suit — wear this outfit, and all of your enemies will chicken out when facing you!
  \
- Chicken Claw — cut, scratch, and slice your foes like the true cocky rooster you are, with a bleeding effect on top of that!
  \
- Chicken Wing — why did the chicken jump off the roof? Well, to soar through the skies with this new paraglider skin.

Test your skills in the Brecken Outfit, shock your enemies with the Voltaic Wrench and fly above the rooftops with Brecken’s Paraglider skin.

items.description:
It’s time to live by your own rules and become the most feared man in The City. Satisfy your hunger for power and wealth as Rais, a powerful warlord who strikes fear in the hearts of all survivors.

Don the Rais’ Outfit, take pleasure in slicing your enemies (both human and Infected) with the Wolfclaw machete, and use the Rais’ Paraglider skin to reside high above anyone else as only the true ruler should.

 **The bundle contains:**  \

- Rais Outfit —  dress as the original cold-blooded villain
- Wolfclaw  — be ruthless to your enemies and cut them up however you like with this sharp machete.
- Rais’ Paraglider  — soar through the sky and bring justice from above.

\

It’s time to live by your own rules with Rais’ Bundle.

bundled_dlc_names: Dying Laugh Weapon — bash foes with your side-splitting proficiency.
Dying Laugh — a horrifying costume like this is no joke.
Dying Laugh Paraglider — a unique paraglider skin. Let’s see who has the last laugh.
items.description:
\
Some clowns have a sweet tooth for violence, and it looks like this one broke off from his circus group. He’s out for blood with an impending need to fulfill his most gruesome fantasies. Luckily for him, there are always enough monster skulls to go around in the City. Take on the identity of a silly yet unpredictable troublemaker to turn every punch into the perfect punchline. \
\
Don a colorful, creepy killer clown mask and costume. Put on an unforgettable show for the unfortunate victims who will have to witness it firsthand. Turn those noses red by unleashing the Dying Laugh Weapon that produces waves of laughter with every hit you make. Additionally, take the Dying Laugh Paraglider to travel from venue to venue and catch involuntary guests by surprise. Let these handy items act as the perfect means to set up a gag that never gets old. After all, in a world where there’s a constant fight for survival, everyone could use a little cheering up. \
\
 **The bundle contains:**  \

- Dying Laugh Weapon — bash foes with your side-splitting proficiency.
- Dying Laugh — a horrifying costume like this is no joke.
- Dying Laugh Paraglider — a unique paraglider skin. Let’s see who has the last laugh.

Chicken Claw — cut, scratch, and slice your foes like the true cocky rooster you are, with a bleeding effect on top of that!
Chicken Wing — why did the chicken jump off the roof? Well, to soar through the skies with this new paraglider skin.
items.description:
Become a one-of-a-kind angry bird.
\
It’s time to shake a tail feather and establish a new pecking order in The City. As a chicken that fears no one, you have to break some bad eggs to make an omelet. Use a claw that can cut and scratch your enemies until they become a chicken-hearted mess. And if someone dares to doubt your ability to fly, prove them wrong by taking it to the skies with a featherweight paraglider.
\
\
**The bundle contains:**
\

- Rooster Suit — wear this outfit, and all of your enemies will chicken out when facing you!
  \
- Chicken Claw — cut, scratch, and slice your foes like the true cocky rooster you are, with a bleeding effect on top of that!
  \
- Chicken Wing — why did the chicken jump off the roof? Well, to soar through the skies with this new paraglider skin.

Voltaic Wrench  — shock your enemies by bashing their heads in.

items.description:
Run, boy, run! Become a strong leader that uses a full array of parkour moves as Brecken, a blast from the past. Run towards a danger, or run away from it when grabbing the loot. Whatever you do, do it for all survivors.

Test your skills in the Brecken Outfit, shock your enemies with the Voltaic Wrench and fly above the rooftops with Brecken’s Paraglider skin.

 **The bundle contains:**  \

- Brecken Outfit — lead the way and move swiftly as one of the first runners.
- Voltaic Wrench  — shock your enemies by bashing their heads in.
- Brecken’s Paraglider — when running is not enough, fly to your destination.

Become a leader that uses a full array of parkour moves with Brecken’s Bundle.

bundled_dlc_names: Rais Outfit —  dress as the original cold-blooded villain
Wolfclaw  — be ruthless to your enemies and cut them up however you like with this sharp machete.
Rais’ Paraglider  — soar through the sky and bring justice from above.
items.description:
It’s time to live by your own rules and become the most feared man in The City. Satisfy your hunger for power and wealth as Rais, a powerful warlord who strikes fear in the hearts of all survivors.

Don the Rais’ Outfit, take pleasure in slicing your enemies (both human and Infected) with the Wolfclaw machete, and use the Rais’ Paraglider skin to reside high above anyone else as only the true ruler should.

 **The bundle contains:**  \

- Rais Outfit —  dress as the original cold-blooded villain
- Wolfclaw  — be ruthless to your enemies and cut them up however you like with this sharp machete.
- Rais’ Paraglider  — soar through the sky and bring justice from above.

\

It’s time to live by your own rules with Rais’ Bundle.

bundled_dlc_names: Dying Laugh Weapon — bash foes with your side-splitting proficiency.
Dying Laugh — a horrifying costume like this is no joke.
Dying Laugh Paraglider — a unique paraglider skin. Let’s see who has the last laugh.
items.description:
\
Some clowns have a sweet tooth for violence, and it looks like this one broke off from his circus group. He’s out for blood with an impending need to fulfill his most gruesome fantasies. Luckily for him, there are always enough monster skulls to go around in the City. Take on the identity of a silly yet unpredictable troublemaker to turn every punch into the perfect punchline. \
\
Don a colorful, creepy killer clown mask and costume. Put on an unforgettable show for the unfortunate victims who will have to witness it firsthand. Turn those noses red by unleashing the Dying Laugh Weapon that produces waves of laughter with every hit you make. Additionally, take the Dying Laugh Paraglider to travel from venue to venue and catch involuntary guests by surprise. Let these handy items act as the perfect means to set up a gag that never gets old. After all, in a world where there’s a constant fight for survival, everyone could use a little cheering up. \
\
 **The bundle contains:**  \

- Dying Laugh Weapon — bash foes with your side-splitting proficiency.
- Dying Laugh — a horrifying costume like this is no joke.
- Dying Laugh Paraglider — a unique paraglider skin. Let’s see who has the last laugh.
